epithet: A Name for a City in the Distance
anti_trude_vector: Twilight plateau-escarpment atmospheric horizon and elevation-coupled nominal dissolution gate: observer vantage on the windy crag brink parts valley mist sponges to reveal pink glow, suspension bridges, and wind-borne signals; descending below the threshold dissolves IRENE into an unnamed local street grid.

canonical_stones.label: Windy Plateau Brink at Twilight
canonical_stones.role: Leaning out from the plateau edge at the hour when lights come on reveals the pink settlement in the valley hollow: concentrated windows, thin dimly lit alleys, garden shadows, and towers with signal fires.

canonical_stones.label: Milky Mist Sponge & Suspension Bridges
canonical_stones.role: On misty evenings a hazy glow swells like a milky sponge at the foot of the gorges until gusts of wind part the vapor over suspension bridges, viaduct arches, domes, and deep ravines.

canonical_stones.label: Shepherd, Bird-Catcher, Hermit & Traveler
canonical_stones.role: Watchers lingering on the windswept escarpment gaze down and project distinct conjectures of life inside Irene without ever descending.

canonical_stones.label: Wind-Borne Drums, Firecrackers & Greenish Flares
canonical_stones.role: Updrafts carry distant bass drums and trumpets, crackle of firecrackers, bursts of machine-gun fire, and greenish sky-flares whose meaning remains suspended between festival and uprising.

canonical_stones.label: Irene Is a Name for a City in the Distance
canonical_stones.role: Approaching and descending below the plateau escarpment dissolves the distant magnet: inside its ordinary streets it changes completely, ceases to be Irene, and would require another name.

watchers.title: Shepherd Shifting His Flock
watchers.vantageNote: Stands by the western cairn with crook and ewes as twilight settles over the gorge.
watchers.conjecture: Conjectures warm lantern-lit wool arcades, sheltered winter folds beneath the viaduct, and peaceful hearth-fires.

watchers.title: Bird-Catcher Watching His Nets
watchers.vantageNote: Crouches along the windward cliff grass beside taut twilight clap-nets.
watchers.conjecture: Conjectures roofed aviaries, string serenades drifting from suspended pergolas, and silk banners snapping in the updraft.

watchers.title: Hermit Gathering Crag Greens
watchers.vantageNote: Leans on an ash staff along the high basalt shelf with a basket of bitter cliff herbs.
watchers.conjecture: Conjectures walled cloister gardens in deep shadow, penitents' vigil lamps, and brazen tower bells warning of vanity.

watchers.title: Traveler Sheltering Behind Crags
watchers.vantageNote: Pauses on the switchback brink wrapping his cloak against the evening gust.
watchers.conjecture: Conjectures crossroads caravanserais, whispered plots under bridge arches, and lovers awaiting a signal flare.

signals.title: Bass Drums & Brass Trumpets
signals.festivalReading: A nocturnal wedding or civic carnival winding with brass horns across the central piazzas.
signals.turmoilReading: Garrison mobilization marching columns toward the gorge bridgeheads.

signals.title: Crackle of Distant Firecrackers
signals.festivalReading: Strings of paper squibs celebrating a feast-night illumination along the terraces.
signals.turmoilReading: Dry timber granaries catching spark in a quarter-wide night conflagration.

signals.title: Staccato Bursts & Greenish Flares
signals.festivalReading: Pyrotechnic Emerald-Star shells launched from the citadel to mark the watch hour.
signals.turmoilReading: Barricade machine-gun bursts under eerie magnesium-green reconnaissance flares.

signals.title: Signal Fires on the Towers
signals.festivalReading: Welcoming resin beacons guiding highland caravans toward the valley gates.
signals.turmoilReading: Quarantine and siege-watch braziers sealing every bridge into the hollow.

causal_invariants.brinkRule: distanceFromHollow >= 0.25 => cityName === 'IRENE' && approachedDirectly === false && isStillIrene === true
causal_invariants.descentRuptureRule: distanceFromHollow < 0.25 => approachedDirectly === true && isStillIrene === false && cityName !== 'IRENE'
